description: Graphical multiplicity (Maurer-Bretz) trial design with alpha recycling. Use when a confirmatory trial has 2+ hypotheses (mixed primary + secondary, dose-response, parent + derived endpoints) where a graph-based procedure preserves family-wise alpha better than Bonferroni. Validates the transition matrix (Rule-3 + row sums) and constructs a graphicalMCP graph object. Sizes each hypothesis at its worst-case alpha; total N is the max across hypotheses. For simpler co-primary or multi-population designs use design_co_primary or design_multi_population instead.

gate_prereqs.description: Optional per-hypothesis prerequisite map. Each entry is the list of hypothesis names that must be rejected before this one can be tested. Used by the Rule-3 validator: every prerequisite must have a non-zero transition into the gated hypothesis.

hypotheses.description: Named map of hypotheses. Each entry has `type` plus the parameters the matching design_<type> wrapper accepts. Continuous uses `mean_diff`, binary uses `p_treatment`, survival uses `hazard_ratio`.

initial_weights.description: Per-hypothesis initial alpha weights. Names match `hypotheses`; sum to <= 1. Hypotheses with weight 0 start un-testable and become testable only after alpha is recycled to them through the transition matrix.

reasoning_chain.description: Optional structured citation trail. Each entry: {decision, value, justification, source_type, source_ref?}. design_report() renders this inline; sponsor_confidential entries trigger a redaction prompt.

items.description: One reasoning-chain entry — a single design decision with its provenance. The LLM and user fill the content; the package validates the shape.

decision.description: Short label for the design choice (e.g., 'alpha', 'hazard_ratio').

justification.description: One sentence explaining why this value was chosen.

source_ref.description: Free-text reference (citation, NCT id, internal protocol number). Optional but encouraged for non-default entries.

source_type.description: Provenance tag for a reasoning-chain entry. Drives the design_report redaction prompt (sponsor_confidential entries flagged before sharing).

value.description: The chosen value (numeric, string, or boolean).

transition_matrix.description: Square (k x k) transition matrix. Row i column j = weight of alpha re-allocated from hypothesis i to hypothesis j upon rejection of i. Each row sums to <= 1; diagonal must be 0 (no self-loops). Order of rows/columns matches the order of `hypotheses`.

worst_case_weights.description: Optional override of the per-hypothesis worst-case weight used for sample-size sizing. Default: max(initial_weight_i, fallback) where fallback = smallest non-zero initial weight.

name: design_graphical_multiplicity
